From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Charlie Novik <charlie@novikanalytics.com>, Sasha Li <sasha@novikanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Thanks for downloading the benchmark — quick 30m to walk through?

Hi Charlie — thanks for downloading the benchmark and interest in Redwood. I pulled a few notes from the report and I think there are three quick areas where a short walkthrough will save time: (1) latency & cost tradeoffs for your long-context use cases, (2) recommended quantization/profile we saw working for similar workloads, and (3) rollout patterns for safe canarying.

Would you and Sasha have 30 minutes this week for a quick walkthrough? I can do:
- Tue May 4, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed May 5, 14:00–14:30 PT

If neither works, shoot over two times that do and I’ll coordinate. I’ve attached a 1-page summary of the benchmark and included a HubSpot link for reference.

Agenda (proposed):
- 5m intros + goal check
- 15m benchmark findings + implications for Novik
- 10m next steps (trial, pricing, technical deep-dive)

Attachments: benchmark_report_summary.pdf (one-pager)

Best,
Ben Carter
Sr. SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

- Tue May 4, 14:30–15:00 ET (which is 11:30–12:00 PT)
- Wed May 5, 16:00–16:30 ET

I attached a short internal note on our evaluation priorities. Also, can you confirm whether the demo will cover: model variant tradeoffs, quantization impact on throughput, and a live look at latency percentiles?
